title: Animate linked background plane transfers
changes: Apply linked transfer frames to background plane tiles in slot order, with selectable slots and frames, adjustable playback rate, looping and persistent controls across descriptors.
Show transfers alone or over linked graphics, expose missing tiles and clip out-of-range destinations without changing source data.
validation: Synthetic viewer unit tiaqrdg1 passed 51 tests; focused unit sahvk9vy passed three independent-timer, composition and controls tests.

Protected EUR unit _7jf5jyj checked 283 independently composed frames, two real frame pixels, unchanged authenticated transfer data and 17 Docker/Python files; the validated ignored world page was published.
limitations: The preview assumes the 0x06000000 tile base and applies complete writes immediately; original live flags, partial DMA, game timing, complete scene composition and Windows remain unverified.
